The '''ISS-7 Guardian Battledroid''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model in service of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] it was stationed aboard the ''[[Emperor's Glory]]'' guarding the [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] control console. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] boarding party from the [[Esseles (starship)|''Esseles'']] confronted the battle droid and destroyed it.

==Behind the scenes==
The ISS-7 guardian battledroid serves as the fourth boss of Flashpoint: the Esseles in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It must be destroyed in order to progress in the flashpoint.
